'''Taval din Chanai Nine Gulls''' is of the [[Sea Folk]] and is [[Windfinder]] of the ''[[White Spray]]''. 

== Appearance ==
She is very young. She has three earrings in each ear.

== Activities ==
She is present when [[Harine din Togara Two Winds]] makes the Bargain with [[Rand al'Thor]], their [[Coramoor]].
